study: Pilot 1 ID1-R1: P3 finite-data system-identification replication
authority: synthetic replication only; tests whether the tiny positive P3 A-N structural-NMSE discrepancy from ID1 persists on a fresh random stream under otherwise unchanged generator, observation, grammar, identifier, sample grid, endpoint, and decision logic

identifier.family: multi-output ridge local transition model over generic polynomial features
identifier.raw_input: current full state (x,theta), intervention descriptor, one-hot step index

readouts.curve_axis: log10 structural_nmse versus log10 total training trajectories

decision_rule.same_sign_but_unstable: primary contrast > 0 but magnitude/curve pattern not comparable to ID1 -> treat as finite/model variance; no interpretation escalation
decision_rule.same_sign_comparable: primary contrast > 0 with broadly comparable magnitude/curve behavior -> earn one additional replication only; still no adaptive-complexity interpretation

scope.changes_from_ID1: fresh confirmatory random stream and P3-only execution; no scientific generator, grammar, estimator, endpoint, or sample-grid change
